newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa says already budgeted for restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa says already budgeted for restructuring.

text.p: Lufthansa chief executive Juergen Weber said the cost of the airline's restructuring announced earlier on Wednesday has already been budgeted for as part of a wider restructuring plan that began in 1994.

Weber told Reuters the reorganisation, in which the airline will create a separately-run division for its passenger services, would lead to the loss of at least 10 percent of Lufthansa's management and administrative jobs.
"The 10 percent reduction is a minimum. It can be more," Weber told Reuters before he was due to speak at an airline conference in Frankfurt.
Weber added that it was "much too early" to assess what cost savings could come from the new moves.
